name: lever deadlift
description: A machine deadlift that lets you hinge and stand up against a set load. Works the glutes, hamstrings and lower back.
instructions: Stand on the platform between the handles with your feet hip-width apart.
Push your hips back, bend your knees and grip the handles at your sides with a flat back.
Drive through your feet and stand up tall, squeezing your glutes.
Lower the handles by pushing your hips back and bending your knees.
Keep your chest up and your back flat throughout.
